anchor_text: <Dialogue speaker="SPEAKER_00" time="18:20">So a couple of episodes back, Father Steven, you made a kind of what I would consider to be a fairly oblique reference to the mother from The Return, season three. And so what I wanted to ask you was, it was kind of a two-parter. First, um, do you think that on the whole, uh, Twin Peaks ended up being a Gnostic work of fiction and is, uh, what happened to Dale Cooper at the end? What do you think?</Dialogue>

<Dialogue speaker="SPEAKER_01" time="01:40:50">But if that's the case, it seems like [[God]] could just be some giant crystal to just like emanate the judgment. Like there's no personal decision. Like does [[Christ]] examine my life and make a personal decision about my life that determines the outcome? Or is it just kind of automatic? It doesn't seem like it can be both.</Dialogue>
